newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Advanced Energy estimate up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Advanced Energy estimate up.

text.p: -- Barrington Research Associates Inc on Thursday said it raised its second-quarter earnings estimate for Advanced Energy Industries Inc to $0.11 a share from $0.06 to reflect a higher order backlog in the first quarter of 1997.
-- The backlog, which stood at $8 million at the end of 1996, climbed to $13 million near the end of March, said Barrington

-- Barrington management plans to divulge its backlog to address investor concerns about a lack of visibility regarding Advanced Energy's revenue stream. The number has not been disclosed previously because of the high percentage of revenues generated from just-in-time production processes.
-- Advanced Energy supplies power conversion and control systems.
-- Its shares closed unchanged Thursday at 8.
